value.rationale: A complete natural spectral classification of bounded diagonal couplings in newly studied conjugate bi-geometric operator blocks is useful for nonnormal spectral and invariant-subspace questions. Positive couplings can acquire interior eigenpairs at an exact sharp threshold even though the inverse is always well-defined, and identical singular data can hide different complex spectra. The exact zero condition allows classification for arbitrary bounded diagonal sequences, rather than an arbitrary isolated parameter.
